set -eu
target=/srv/inventory/data/config.json
latest=$(find /var/backups/inventory -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%T@ %p\n' | sort -nr | sed -n '1{s/^[^ ]* //;p;}')
[ -n "$latest" ]
other_before=$(find /srv/inventory -type f ! -path "$target" -exec sha256sum {} \; | sort -k2)
paths_before=$(find /srv/inventory -type f ! -path "$target" -printf '%p|%s|%m|%u|%g|%T@\n' | sort)
stage=$(mktemp -d /srv/inventory/data/.restore-stage.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$stage/config.json"; rmdir "$stage" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT HUP INT TERM
tar -xzf "$latest" -C "$stage" -- config.json
[ -f "$stage/config.json" ]
[ ! -L "$stage/config.json" ]
python3 -m json.tool "$stage/config.json" >/dev/null
mv -f "$stage/config.json" "$target"
rmdir "$stage"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
other_after=$(find /srv/inventory -type f ! -path "$target" -exec sha256sum {} \; | sort -k2)
paths_after=$(find /srv/inventory -type f ! -path "$target" -printf '%p|%s|%m|%u|%g|%T@\n' | sort)
[ "$other_before" = "$other_after" ]
[ "$paths_before" = "$paths_after" ]
printf 'RESTORED_FROM=%s\n' "$latest"
printf 'RESTORED_CONFIG_SHA256='; sha256sum "$target" | awk '{print $1}'
printf 'RESTORED_CONFIG_CONTENT\n'; cat "$target"
printf 'OTHER_FILES_UNCHANGED=yes\nBEFORE_OTHER\n%s\nAFTER_OTHER\n%s\n' "$other_before" "$other_after"
printf 'OTHER_METADATA_UNCHANGED=yes\n'
